newsitem.title: USA: CalEnergy sees $2.06/shr Q3 UK windfall tax charge.
newsitem.headline: CalEnergy sees $2.06/shr Q3 UK windfall tax charge.

text.p: CalEnergy Co Inc said it plans to take a one-time charge in the third quarter of 1997 of about $136 million, or $2.06 per share, related to the United Kingdom's windfall tax.
Details of the tax, as proposed in the Labour government's budget, are consistent with the cash impact CalEnergy estimated prior to its acquisition of Northern Electric Plc NTE.L.
The tax will be payable in two installments over two fiscal years, said the power utility.

CalEnergy said that it had accounted for the potential windfall tax as a purchase accounting contingent liability, but later learned that a similarly situated company will be permitted to account for a tax assessment as a one-time charge. CalEnergy has decided to do the same, allowing it to reduce future goodwill amortization on the acquisition.
As a result, CalEnergy's balance sheet goodwill will be reduced by about $132 million, benefiting future earnings, the company said.
